text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 2460 Keele Street.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated January 27, 2019, regarding the property located at 2460 Keele Street, Folder No. 19 264142 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to May 30, 2021. 2. Directed the Appellant to clean the existing garbage area immediately and on a weekly basis, and to the satisfaction of the Municipal Standards Officer to address any potential health and safety issues that may arise during the extension to May 30, 2021.
